images.author: Lucas County (Ohio). Auditor's Office
images.caption: This image was produced by the Auditor's Office in Lucas County, Ohio for tax assessment purposes. Associated dates are approximate. Descriptive terms related to this photograph include: dwelling | 17

facade.notes: the Lucas County Auditor block card: a tax-assessment photo with the parcel number in frame: a 1950s one-storey ranch in white shingle siding, shuttered double-hung windows and a picture window, a flush garage door at the end, small foundation shrubs on a raw lawn, a TV mast; the next house a mirror of it

why.note: the postwar tract ranch: one storey on a slab, the garage folded into the house end
